name: prompt-marks
description: Marks your prompts in the transcript with a colored bar and tinted row, and jumps between them with Option+Up and Option+Down

accent_color.title: Accent color
accent_color.description: Hex color of the bar left of each prompt; the row tint is mixed from it

tint_strength.title: Tint strength
tint_strength.description: Percent of the accent color mixed into the terminal background behind each prompt
